title: Give each decision a short brief written for Daniel
tier_reason: Reversible local work authorized by Daniel; verify the result before completion.
ask:
Implement section 3 of docs/hq/HUMAN_INTERFACE_PLAN.md. Daniel authorized this redesign on 2026-09-21. Preserve the acceptance requirements in that section and coordinate with the other sections. Do not duplicate existing deliverable gate w44ff2049d9a.

Implement the shared review title rule in the plan: short deliverable name separate from original agent ask, rendered as Review: <deliverable>. Cover card creation paths and legacy fallback; preserve history.
first_action: Read docs/hq/HUMAN_INTERFACE_PLAN.md section 3, inspect the current behavior and linked work, then implement and verify the specified outcome.
source_message: Daniel authorized the HQ redesign cards and a temporary Claude/Codex execution rule, followed by one supervised run.
result:
Review cards now display `Review: <deliverable>` across both HQ review views. New results record a short deliverable name separately from the original agent ask; the build queue, read-only work path, and Animation Lab all populate it. Existing cards keep their recorded title as a safe fallback.

The review layout now puts Daniel’s question and recommendation before the result, with the agent brief below the decision controls. Existing evidence is preserved when a revised result receives a new review name; the deliverable readiness check was unchanged.

Verified JavaScript syntax, Python compilation, and the focused Work, drain, and queue-readiness tests.

model_selection.policy: Cost-conscious redesign: Terra build, Sol review once, escalate only when needed.
